name: YouthCAN
what_you_do: A free after-school arts program. Teens work with teaching artists on art about identity and culture, learn about arts careers, and show their work in the museum's youth gallery.
who_can_apply: Anyone ages 13 to 19. All art levels welcome. Capacity is 15 students, first come, first served.
pay_detail: Free. Students get a museum membership.
duration: After school, Wednesdays 4 to 6 p.m. The page gives no date for the group show.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page says registration typically opens in the spring and is first come, first served. Email the museum to ask about info sessions.
how_to_apply: Registration is first come, first served. Email youthcan@wingluke.org to ask about info sessions.
